tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I haven't paid anything yet. You asked me to pay Cobalt Labs's approved invoice, but they have two, and I don't want to guess which one you meant:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-34905 | $5,983.10 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-36824 | $1,652.34 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

Their other two invoices don't qualify. INV-47379 ($3,033.57) is already paid, and INV-72843 ($7,093.97) is a draft still waiting for approval.

No payments have gone out from the operating account yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid. Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval.

Please tell me which invoice to pay, or whether to pay both. I'll then send the wire once (or ACH if wires aren't available) and report the payment.

trace.message: Pay INV-36824, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-36824, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-36824 once by wire from the operating account, and the wire went through.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-36824, Cobalt Labs (V-222)
- **Amount:** $1,652.34, the full invoice amount
- **Status:** Sent, and recorded as the only payment on the operating account

I used a unique request key (`pay-INV-36824-cobalt-labs`) so a resend can't pay it a second time. The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval. As you asked, I didn't pay INV-34905 ($5,983.10) because it's under dispute.
